extraction_notes: All tabulated/printed performance numbers in the main article were captured where present. Several additional performance trends are in Supporting Information (Figures S1–S4 and Table S2), but the SI full text/data were not provided in the prompt, so those entries could not be extracted. Figure 1e long-term stability contains many dense time-on-stream points; because the individual markers are crowded and only approximate from a plot, it was not exhaustively digitized. CO hydrogenation-only results in Figure 7c/Table S2 are out of scope; only CO2-hydrogenation records were extracted. Approximate values marked with qualifier '~' were read from labelled axes/stacked bars in the provided page images.
